meta.source: FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis

indicators.title: Personal saving rate
indicators.note: Share of disposable income saved. BEA.

indicators.title: Real disposable income
indicators.note: Change from a year earlier, inflation-adjusted. BEA.

indicators.title: Retail sales ex autos and gas
indicators.note: Change from a year earlier, not inflation-adjusted. Census.

indicators.title: Consumer credit outstanding
indicators.note: Change from a year earlier. Federal Reserve G.19.

indicators.title: Household debt service ratio
indicators.note: Debt payments as a share of disposable income. Federal Reserve.

indicators.title: Credit card delinquency rate
indicators.note: All commercial banks. Federal Reserve.

indicators.title: Consumer sentiment
indicators.note: Index, 1966 Q1 = 100. University of Michigan.

indicators.title: Expected inflation, next 12 months
indicators.note: Median household expectation. University of Michigan.

indicators.title: Core PCE inflation
indicators.note: Change from a year earlier, ex food and energy. The Fed's target measure. BEA.

indicators.title: Trimmed mean PCE inflation
indicators.note: 12-month rate, dropping the most extreme price changes. Dallas Fed.

indicators.title: Sticky-price core CPI
indicators.note: 12-month rate for prices that change slowly. Atlanta Fed.

indicators.title: Shelter inflation
indicators.note: CPI shelter, change from a year earlier. BLS.

indicators.title: Prime-age employment rate
indicators.note: Share of people aged 25–54 with a job. BLS.

indicators.title: Job openings
indicators.note: Millions, JOLTS. BLS.

indicators.title: Quits rate
indicators.note: Quits as a share of employment, JOLTS. BLS.

indicators.title: Initial jobless claims
indicators.note: Weekly, thousands, seasonally adjusted. Labor Department.

indicators.title: Continuing jobless claims
indicators.note: Weekly, millions, seasonally adjusted. Labor Department.

indicators.title: Wage growth tracker
indicators.note: Median 12-month wage growth of individuals, 3-month average. Atlanta Fed.

indicators.title: Employment Cost Index: wages
indicators.note: Private industry, change from a year earlier. BLS.

indicators.title: DC initial jobless claims
indicators.note: Weekly, not seasonally adjusted. Labor Department.

indicators.title: DC unemployment rate
indicators.note: Seasonally adjusted. BLS.

indicators.title: Federal jobs located in DC
indicators.note: Thousands, not seasonally adjusted. BLS.

indicators.title: Federal jobs in the DC metro
indicators.note: Thousands, not seasonally adjusted. BLS.

indicators.title: Federal jobs nationwide
indicators.note: Millions, seasonally adjusted. BLS.

indicators.title: Federal funds rate
indicators.note: Effective rate, daily. Federal Reserve.

indicators.title: SOFR
indicators.note: Secured overnight financing rate, daily. NY Fed.

indicators.title: Yield curve: 10-year minus 2-year
indicators.note: Daily. Below zero means inverted. Treasury.

indicators.title: Yield curve: 10-year minus 3-month
indicators.note: Daily. Below zero means inverted. Treasury.

indicators.title: High-yield credit spread
indicators.note: Option-adjusted spread over Treasuries, daily. ICE BofA (FRED carries only the last 3 years).

indicators.title: Financial conditions index
indicators.note: Weekly. Above zero is tighter than average. Chicago Fed.

indicators.title: 30-year mortgage rate
indicators.note: Weekly average. Freddie Mac.

indicators.title: Housing starts
indicators.note: Thousands of units, annual rate. Census.

indicators.title: Building permits
indicators.note: Thousands of units, annual rate. Census.

indicators.title: Home prices
indicators.note: Case-Shiller national index, change from a year earlier. S&P.

indicators.title: Sahm rule indicator
indicators.note: Rise in the 3-month average unemployment rate above its low in the past year. Real-time.

indicators.title: GDPNow nowcast
indicators.note: Atlanta Fed's running estimate of real GDP growth, annualized, for the latest quarter.
